extracted.intended_audience: researchers, prospective postgraduate students, Imperial staff, industry partners and business
extracted.subtask_description: Statements and expectations describing the research environment and priorities at Imperial College London, including measures of excellence, institutional values (integrity, governance, best practice), collaborative multidisciplinary focus, and support for researchers and partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Excellence (REF)
rubrics_metrics.description: Imperial has a greater proportion of world-leading research than any other UK university, according to the REF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions the REF as the benchmark for institutional research quality and public claim of national leadership in 'world-leading' research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Culture of integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: We support and nurture a research environment that is defined by a culture of integrity, good governance and best practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutional expectation that research activity adheres to high ethical standards and integrity; presented as a core characteristic of the research environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Good governance
rubrics_metrics.description: We support and nurture a research environment that is defined by a culture of integrity, good governance and best practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises organisational structures, oversight and policies that ensure responsible conduct and management of research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best practice
rubrics_metrics.description: We support and nurture a research environment that is defined by a culture of integrity, good governance and best practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calls for adoption of recognised best practices across research activities; implies continuous improvement and adherence to professional norms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ambitious, real-world impact focus
rubrics_metrics.description: From climate change to disease prevention, Imperial researchers and global partners ask bigger questions to solve real world challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames research success by scope and societal relevance — prioritises work addressing major global problems and translational impact through partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative, multidisciplinary community
rubrics_metrics.description: Our highly ambitious, collaborative, multidisciplinary community of researchers possess a common goal of tackling the biggest scientific challenges of our time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values teamwork across disciplines and international partnerships; indicates evaluation preference for collaborative and cross-disciplinary approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for staff, partners and business; research opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Research with us at Imperial; Postgraduate research degrees; PhD vacancies; Support for staff; Support for partners and business; A-Z Imperial research groups; Find a researcher; Research Excellence Framework (REF).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists institutional resources and entry points — implies availability of structured support, career/researcher development, and routes for engagement (postgraduate recruitment, industry partnerships, research groups).
